issues.label: Financial misconduct finding on share transfers
issues.why: R.C. 3105.171(E) requires the court to address whether Mahendra's gifting of Vora Ventures shares constituted financial misconduct warranting compensatory or distributive award.

issues.label: Failure to make required misconduct findings
issues.why: The court allegedly made no specific factual findings on the alleged misconduct, which may be reversible error.

issues.label: Dissipation of marital assets
issues.why: Court must determine whether the transfers dissipated marital assets and whether an unequal division is warranted to compensate Sangita.

issues.label: Validity and effect of Sangita's signatures
issues.why: Whether Sangita's undisputed signatures on transfer/consent documents bind her despite claiming ignorance of their contents.

issues.label: Timing of transfers relative to separation
issues.why: Whether transfers occurred before or after separation affects whether they were legitimate estate planning or divorce planning.

issues.label: Credibility of family testimony
issues.why: Court must weigh Mahendra's and daughters' testimony against Sangita's denial of involvement in estate planning discussions.

issues.label: Jurisdiction to alter corporate structure
issues.why: Whether the court correctly concluded it lacked authority to disregard the operating agreements versus equitably compensating Sangita in property division.

issues.label: Equitable vs. equal division of Vora Ventures
issues.why: Whether awarding Sangita half of only the 62% rather than half of 100% was equitable under R.C. 3105.171.

issues.label: Stipulated $96 million valuation binding effect
issues.why: The parties stipulated Vora Ventures' value, constraining valuation but not the division analysis.

issues.label: Application of foreign law (Civ.R. 44.1)
issues.why: Court must properly determine and apply Indian law regarding the HUF as noticed under Civ.R. 44.1.

issues.label: Proper creation of the MV HUF
issues.why: Whether Mahendra validly formed the Hindu Undivided Family entity under Indian law.

issues.label: Transfer of AnuPriya to HUF
issues.why: Whether Mahendra's declarations transferred AnuPriya despite title remaining in his name, and its consequent marital status.

issues.label: Transfer of SGV shares to HUF
issues.why: Whether the SGV shares were properly transferred to the HUF and remained marital property.

issues.label: Marital character of HUF assets
issues.why: Whether assets placed in the HUF remain marital property subject to division despite the entity's legal separateness.

issues.label: Sangita's status as HUF member
issues.why: Whether her status as a 'member' with no vested interest affects the divisibility of HUF assets.

issues.label: Bank of Baroda account classification
issues.why: Court must determine whether the account is in the HUF and its marital status.

issues.label: Valuation of AnuPriya
issues.why: Court must resolve competing JLL and Colliers appraisals differing by roughly $6 million.

issues.label: Valuation of SGV interest
issues.why: Court must resolve competing valuations of Mahendra's 15% SGV interest differing by roughly $3 million.

issues.label: SGV partner debt deduction
issues.why: Whether the ~87 million rupee debt to partners should reduce the SGV valuation and its evidentiary support.

issues.label: Currency conversion formula and rate
issues.why: Court must determine the proper rupee-to-dollar conversion for Indian assets, disputed in the final decree.

issues.label: Spousal support determination
issues.why: Whether the $10,000 monthly award properly applied all R.C. 3105.18 factors given the large property award.

issues.label: Interest-free payment plan equity
issues.why: Whether the seven-year no-interest deferral of Sangita's $18.3 million share is equitable.

issues.label: Interest rate on deferred property payment
issues.why: Whether 5% interest after seven years, versus statutory or requested 10%, is appropriate.

issues.label: Restraint on transferring Vora Ventures interest
issues.why: Whether the injunction adequately secures Sangita's deferred payment.

issues.label: Goldman Sachs accounts valuation date
issues.why: Court must set the correct valuation date for these accounts as disputed in the decree.

issues.label: Duration of marriage and homemaker contribution
issues.why: Long marriage and Sangita's non-economic contributions bear on equitable division and support.

issues.label: Adequacy of Sangita's immediate liquidity
issues.why: Whether her access to $8.7 million immediately affects the fairness of the deferred payment structure.

issues.label: Non-marital trusts holding daughters' shares
issues.why: Whether assignment of shares to daughters' non-marital trusts places them beyond reach of division.
